capabilities: create and edit snippets in a modal
insert snippets into notes via commands
manage stored snippets in an interface
auto-insert snippets from the last typed word
specify programming language for code snippets
extras: README is bilingual (English and French); the demonstration sections reference screenshots that are not included in the text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to store and quickly reuse reusable text or code fragments across notes.
summary: Snippet manager that lets you create, edit, and insert text or code snippets into notes, including automatic insertion after typing a snippet's name.
